_doc: Multi-Spirling battle extras (docs/KAMPF_PLAN_1000.md, Mehrfachkämpfe), read by scripts/battle/MultiRules.gd. formation: when a side fields at least 'count' Spirlings of 'element' at the start of a battle with several slots, each of them starts with these stat stages. tower: every 'every'-th lighthouse stair floor that is no Warden floor is fought 'front' against 'front'. support_turns: default turns of the support arts (team_guard, decoy, cover). guard_mult: damage taken by a side under a team guard. swarm: a wild swarm's highest-ring Spirling leads it with leader_stage; when it falls, the rest get falter_stage. combos: when an ally already hit a foe this turn with one element of a pair, a hit with the other element on the same foe deals combo_mult. rows: in a side with more than front_slots slots, the slots after them stand in the back row: physical arts on them deal back_phys_taken, their own physical arts deal back_phys_dealt (sweeps and Focus arts are not changed).
